0022600178.text: The Memphis Grizzlies (6-0, first in the Southwest and the West, 2-0 at home, riding a six-game winning streak) host the Indiana Pacers (2-6, 0-4 at home, on a five-game losing streak, 12th in the East and 4.5 games back in the Central) in Memphis's eighth game of the season. Memphis is without Quinten Post (ankle) and Scotty Pippen Jr. (back soreness), while Indiana is missing Aaron Nesmith (rest), Andrew Nembhard (neck), Ben Sheppard (knee), Ivica Zubac (ankle sprain), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery), Kelly Oubre Jr. (knee bruise), Larry Nance Jr. (illness), Obi Toppin (coach's decision, soreness), Pascal Siakam (rest), T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain), and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain). The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and Memphis won the 2025-26 season series 2-0, including a 125-106 road win in Indianapolis on March 1, 2026.
